content: OFL-1.1 permits bundling/embedding fonts (including subset 'Modified Versions') inside an application provided the copyright statement, license notice, and full license text are included alongside the distribution (a LICENSE/OFL.txt file, matching the existing frontend/src/assets/fonts/OFL.txt precedent in this repo). Subsetting is allowed but is itself a 'Modified Version' requiring no renaming of the family for internal bundled use (renaming is only required if the modified font is redistributed as a font under a different license/product name) as long as reserved font names aren't reused for a separately-distributed derivative. No royalty/registration needed.
